描述_EN: cizhou wares were popular wares, made for everyday use, and so were much more free-spirited in form and surface design than the wares made at the imperial kilns for the very elite, which tended to be more focused on the perfection of the form and firing process. this jar, in the form of a peony, is typical of cizhou ware in its stoneware body given an even colour through the use of a white slip (a thinned firing clay spread over the surface, which gives opaque, even colour). cizhou is a term used to describe a variety of ceramics made in northern china during the song dynasty (960-1279).
描述_ZN: 慈禧器物是大众化的器物，为日常使用而制作，因此在形式和表面设计上比御用窑场为精英们制作的器物更自由，后者更注重形式和烧制过程的完美。 此罐为牡丹造型，是典型的贵州器物，其炻器器身通过使用白滑（一种稀薄的烧制泥土，涂抹在表面，使其颜色不透明、均匀）而获得了均匀的颜色。 在中国北方的宋代（960-1279年）的陶瓷中，"Cizhou "是一个用来描述各种陶瓷的术语。
